items.prompt: White to move. The knight takes the undefended rook on d5. By the counting values, how many points does White win?

claims.statement: Nxd5 wins a rook and nothing is lost back.
No black piece defends the rook.

hints: Which piece is being taken?
Is anything given up in return?
A rook has a counting value of five.
items.explain: Nothing defends the rook, so White wins a whole rook: 5 points by the counting values.
